name: featherless
description: OpenAI-compatible inference on thousands of open models with Featherless
long_description: Bring a Featherless API key; the gateway keeps it off your Sprite and sends it as a bearer token. Saving, replacing or testing the key reads the key's plan (GET /v1/plan), which runs no inference. A Sprite can then list and inspect models, run chat and text completions (including SSE streaming), create embeddings, tokenize text, score questions with the classifier, list speech voices and synthesize speech. On the Developer and Pay-As-You-Go plans inference uses your Featherless credits; on Chat plans it counts against your concurrent-unit allowance. Credit balance, usage activity, the concurrency stream, API keys, billing and account management are not forwarded.

messages.400: Featherless rejected the request (%{status}); check the error message for an unsupported parameter, a context or max_tokens limit, or a cold model
messages.403: Featherless denied the request; check the model's licence, Hugging Face gate or your plan, or the error message for a security block
messages.422: Featherless could not validate the request body; see error.details
messages.429: Featherless concurrent-unit or model-switch limit reached; reduce parallel requests and retry later
messages.503: Featherless has no capacity for this model right now; retry with backoff or choose another model
messages.provider_unreachable: Could not reach Featherless; retry later

notices.title: Billing
notices.body: Saving or testing the key reads `GET /v1/plan`, which runs no inference and costs nothing. On the Developer and Pay-As-You-Go plans, successful chat and text completions, embeddings and classifier calls are charged per input and output token, and speech per input character, against your credit balance; responses report the charge as `usage.cost`. On Chat plans requests are unlimited within your concurrent-unit allowance. Listing models and voices, reading the plan and tokenizing are not documented as billed.

notices.title: Scope
notices.body: Only `GET /v1/plan`, `GET /v1/models`, `GET /v1/models/:owner/:model`, `POST /v1/chat/completions`, `POST /v1/completions`, `POST /v1/embeddings`, `POST /v1/tokenize`, `POST /v1/classifier`, `GET /v1/audio/voices` and `POST /v1/audio/speech` are forwarded. Credit balance, usage activity, the account concurrency stream, API keys, billing and account management are not.

usage_notes: Model ids are `owner/model` and go into the path as two segments: `GET /v1/models/Qwen/Qwen3.8-27B`. The URL-encoded single-segment form (`%2F`) is refused by the gateway.
The gateway waits 120 seconds for response headers. Featherless documents no server-side timeout parameter, so stream long completions (`stream: true`) or keep `max_tokens` small.

Errors are `{"error": {"message", "type", "param", "code"}}`. A 400 can mean a bad parameter, a context limit or a cold model; a 429 is a concurrent-unit or model-switch limit, not a request-rate limit.
`POST /v1/completions` still works, but Featherless no longer supports it officially; prefer `POST /v1/chat/completions`.
